If a message receives an execution attempt count of $\ge 2$ without an explicit ACK or graceful retry exception, the broker shunts the envelope directly to `sorrel-notifier-parked-[region]`, emits alert `notifier-message-parked`, and proceeds to the next item on the primary queue.
